raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview Python builds each legacy completions `top_logprobs` entry, and each `prompt_logprobs` entry, as a dict over the engine's logprobs row, so the JSON keys come in the engine's order with the sampled (or prompt) token first. Rust collected both into a `HashMap`, so key order varied between identical requests. This PR keeps the engine's order. One commit per surface. ## Claims - Completions `top_logprobs` keys, and `prompt_logprobs` keys on chat and completions, come out in the engine's order with the sampled or prompt token first, as in Python. - A repeated key keeps its first position and takes the last value, which is Python's dict semantics. - This unblocks the completions cases of `tests/entrypoints/openai/test_return_tokens_as_ids.py`, which read the first key of each echoed `top_logprobs` entry as the prompt token (`next(iter(...))`). ## Validation Commands from `.buildkite/scripts/run-rust-frontend-cargo-ci.sh` (`style-clippy` and `test`), run from the repo root: ``` cargo fmt --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --all -- --check # ok cargo sort --workspace --check rust # ok cargo deny --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --config rust/deny.toml check bans # ok cargo clippy --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --workspace --all-targets --all-features --locked -- -D warnings # ok cargo nextest run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --workspace --all-features --locked --no-fail-fast # 2312 tests run: 2312 passed, 13 skipped ``` The first commit alone also passes workspace clippy and nextest. - `completion_top_logprobs_keep_engine_order`: engine row `[C, A, B, C]` gives `{"C","A","B"}`, for strings and for `token_id:N`. - `prompt_logprobs_maps_keep_engine_order`: keys `[3, 1, 2]`. - Both fail with `HashMap` and pass with the fix. ## Details Python: `append_logprobs_for_next_position` (`vllm/logprobs.py`), then the dict comprehension in `_create_completion_logprobs` (`vllm/entrypoints/openai/completion/serving.py:774-791`). Change: `LogProbs.top_logprobs` and `PromptLogprobs` (`rust/src/server/src/routes/openai/utils/types.rs`) hold `IndexMap`s, collected in the engine row's order. `IndexMap`'s `FromIterator` already keeps a repeated key at its first position with the last value, so no extra dedup is needed. The workspace `indexmap` dependency gains its `serde` feature; no new crate. The order is a property of the wire DTOs, whose only producers are the two converters in `utils/logprobs.rs`. The decoded entries from `vllm-text` already arrive in engine order, so only the DTO's map type changes. Not a duplicate: no open PR changes the Rust logprobs map type. AI assistance (Claude Code) was used to prepare this change; the human submitter reviewed every changed line. 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) https://claude.ai/code/session_01K2SEJPm2Mawmm6pu8m9E1o ---
Pull Request Checklist - [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans). - [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR. - [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity. - [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI. - [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples. - [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.
